estimate_basis: 18,274 full predicted models; sensitive prefilter and up to 2,000 hits per query. No empirical runtime calibration yet; broad planning range. Reuse source files through symlinks and preserve Foldseek intermediates.
cost: Existing CPU host; no paid infrastructure
scope: Full frozen marker-model snapshots, not the full proteome atlas. Similarity groups require threshold, source/confidence and representative/member validation; never equated to orthogroups.
